We are looking for an experienced carpenter specialized in roofing. You have several years of experience, can work independently, and deliver high-quality results. You speak Dutch and/or English and hold a Category B driving license. You are willing to work on sites in West and East Flanders.

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

Your responsibilities:

• Coordinate the administration related to invoices and commitments, including leasing, housekeeping, payroll, real estate taxes and travel expenses.
• Monitor relevant expenditures against budget and follow up with external parties such as suppliers, municipalities and surveyors when required.
• Coordinate the external audit process and prepare or review audit documentation and samples.
• Review account reconciliations, including accruals, prepayments and suspense accounts, as well as payroll reconciliations in cooperation with the Payroll Manager.
• Contribute to month-end closing and management reporting by analysing account movements and explaining significant fluctuations.
• Ensure accurate intercompany accounting and recharges.
• Coordinate VAT, real estate tax and other relevant tax compliance activities together with the Tax department.
• Support budgeting activities and the preparation and review of statutory accounts.
• Contribute to financial reporting for subsidiaries in line with IFRS and local GAAP.
• Support accounting activities related to mergers, acquisitions and entity integrations.
• Coordinate local GAAP accounting memos where required.
• Ensure appropriate accounting procedures, controls and systems are implemented and followed.
• Participate in European finance projects, including system implementations, entity integrations, IFRS migrations and updates to policies and procedures.
• Contribute to process improvements and other ad-hoc finance projects.
• Support the Accounting Manager in guiding the Corporate Accounting team and provide advice on non-routine accounting matters.
• Help onboard and train new and existing team members.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent professional experience.
• At least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Solid experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within a services or retail environment.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with CRM/ERP migration or upgrade projects, particularly UAT, key-user or training responsibilities.
• SAP experience is required; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
• Experience in a multi-country or shared-services environment is a plus.
• Previous management experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English and French. German is considered a strong asset, while additional market languages are a plus.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft applications and advanced Excel skills.

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability.

You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)

·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude

·        A professional and presentable appearance

·        Proficiency in Dutch or English

·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a complex retail and logistics environment. Technology plays a central role in supporting business operations, and the company is investing in delivering a high-quality IT support experience to its internal users.The position is based in the Dilbeek area.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Service Desk Support Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
• Logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and managing tickets through the ITSM platform.
• Performing first-line troubleshooting and resolving technical issues whenever possible.
• Supporting end-user devices, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and standard business applications.
• Assisting users with Microsoft 365 tools, Windows environments, user account administration, and connectivity issues.
• Managing and monitoring tickets through to resolution while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Escalating incidents to second-line support teams, external providers, or specialist teams when required.
• Following up on escalated incidents and ensuring timely resolution.
• Documenting solutions, workarounds, and recurring incidents to enrich the knowledge base.
• Collaborating with IT colleagues to improve processes, service quality, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will possess:

• Professional proficiency in French and Dutch, both written and spoken.
• A working knowledge of English for internal communication.
• Previous experience in IT support, service desk, helpdesk, or end-user support functions.
• Exposure to several of the following technologies:
• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
• Windows environments and first-level troubleshooting
• Active Directory and user administration
• Networking and connectivity fundamentals
• End-user hardware and peripherals
• Mobile device support
• Strong customer service and communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills with a structured approach to ticket management.
• Analytical problem-solving capabilities and the ability to prioritize effectively.
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine desire to develop technical skills further.

Do you enjoy working accurately and prefer a hands-on job?
 

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.
 

What will you do?
 

- Check the quality and quantity of products before packing.
- Carefully pack parts according to the required specifications.
- Process orders based on instructions provided through a computer system or order form.
- Handle parts weighing up to 10 kg.

- You speak and understand Dutch or English.
- You are comfortable with standing work and handling parts up to 10 kg.
- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately.
- You are looking for a full-time position and work in a precise and structured way.

Our customer is an international organisation who specialises in the packaging of machine parts with a focus on efficiency and excellence. Their Core Values are flexibility, quality, speed and discretion.

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented, reliable, and looking for a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment? Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you!

 

We’re looking for enthusiastic employees to do the packaging of a wide variety of machine parts in Lokeren. As a Packaging Employee, you'll make sure our products are packed with care and precision, ready to be delivered to customers worldwide. For this job, you will use a scanning system and a computer to ensure everything is registered correctly.

Who are we looking for?

• Comfortable standing for long periods without discomfort.
• Available for long-term work, full-time from monday to friday.
• Lifting weights up to 10 kg is not a problem (no physical issues).
• Able to communicate in English and/or Dutch
• Experience as a packaging employee is a plus.

Deze international is gespecialiseerd in de productie en de toelevering van kunststofonderdelen voor de automobielindustrie; spuitgietonderdelen voor voertuigen.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment.

• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

Are you a handy jack-of-all-rounder with a passion for maintenance? Then I'm looking for you!

For a company in Aalter that specializes in structural steel, I'm looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician!

What will your responsibilities be?

• 
You'll perform preventive and corrective maintenance on pneumatic, mechanical, and hydraulic systems.

• 
You'll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.

• 
You'll work in a technical team where everyone is committed to optimization.

• 
You'll strictly adhere to safety regulations.

• 
You'll conduct quality checks.

Who are you?

• 
You have a technical mindset! This is reflected in your experience or technical training.

• 
You preferably have knowledge of pneumatic, hydraulic, and/or mechanical systems.

• 
You have experience with preventive maintenance.

• 
You are passionate about troubleshooting and resolving issues.

• 
You speak English or Dutch.

• 
Polish or Romanian is a plus!

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in storage, transport and handling of goods. Based in the city of Ghent in Belgium, the company has offices around the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management. Katoen Natie Ghent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has strong ties with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

 

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.
• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.
• You speak fluent English and Dutch
• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.
• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.
• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.
• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.
• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

Our client is an international player in operational leasing and fleet management, offering innovative and flexible mobility solutions to business customers. Operating within a major automotive group, the company combines strong market expertise with a broad partner network and a focus on sustainable mobility.As part of the continued development of its Belgian activities, the company is reinforcing its Sales & Marketing department.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting to the Sales Director, you will play a key role in identifying and developing new business opportunities, strengthening existing relationships and increasing the company's market presence.You will work closely with internal stakeholders, including the group's B2B automotive network, Marketing, Credit and Operations teams, to maximise commercial opportunities and achieve shared business objectives.Your responsibilities will include:

• Identify, develop and manage new business opportunities and strategic partnerships.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective clients and business partners, acting as their main point of contact.
• Increase the company's visibility by attending relevant industry events and networking opportunities.
• Advise corporate clients on their specific mobility challenges, particularly regarding the transition towards more sustainable mobility solutions.
• Work closely with the group's automotive dealer network to maximise cross-selling opportunities and revenue generation.
• Manage tenders and prepare tailored commercial proposals based on customer requirements.
• Monitor account performance, analyse commercial results and identify opportunities to improve volumes and profitability.
• Ensure the quality and long-term development of your client portfolio through proactive account management and a strong customer focus.
• Contribute to commercial strategy by analysing market trends and identifying new growth opportunities.

• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good professional command of English.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing or a related field.
• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales or a similar commercial position.
• Proven ability to develop business relationships and build a strong professional network.
• Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
• Strong analytical capabilities and a strategic mindset.
• Proactive, entrepreneurial and results-oriented, with the ability to work autonomously.
• Customer-focused, commercially driven and comfortable collaborating with multiple internal stakeholders.

🚀 Experienced operations leader with a strong background in dispatch, warehousing, vendor management, compliance, team leadership, and continuous improvement, ensuring smooth logistics operations in fast-paced and highly regulated environments.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Global leader in specialized logistics and transportation solutions. The company supports time-critical shipments across healthcare, life sciences and other highly regulated industries, ensuring products reach their destination safely, securely and on time.

 

Omschrijving

• Led the daily operations of dispatch and driver teams, ensuring smooth workflows and optimal resource planning
• Managed and developed vendor partnerships, including sourcing, onboarding, performance reviews, and cost negotiations
• Ensured exceptional service levels and quick resolution of operational issues
• Oversaw compliance with ADR, Air Cargo Security, GDP, AEO, and other regulatory requirements
• Coordinated shift planning and maintained 24/7 operational coverage
• Drove continuous improvement initiatives and implemented operational changes where needed
• Managed KPI tracking, reporting, CAPA follow-up, and quality performance
• Supported recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance management of team members
• Developed contingency plans and acted as the first escalation point for urgent out-of-hours incidents
• Collaborated closely with leadership on customer satisfaction, operational performance, and strategic improvements
 

 

• 5+ years of hands-on operations experience
• Dutch, English and French fluent
• Solid background in dispatching, warehousing, and temperature-controlled logistics
• Experienced in live animal handling 🐾
• Strong knowledge of ADR, Air Cargo Security, GDP & AEO regulations
• Skilled in warehouse operations, dispatch coordination, and logistics processes
• Proven track record in managing supplier and vendor relationships
• Comfortable being on-call for urgent situations when needed
• Flexible and adaptable, with availability for shift work (06:00-19:00)
• Able to work independently while thriving in a fast-paced team environment 🚀

With around 1,000 ‘Brabantians’, we are responsible for the worldwide production, marketing, sales and distribution of our Designed for Living products.

Brabantia has factories in Latvia, China and Belgium. At the Pelt site, we produce not only waste bins, but also bread bins and storage canisters. Adjacent to the production site is our distribution centre, from which Brabantia products are distributed worldwide.

More than 350 employees work at the Pelt site.

Jobomschrijving

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Manually picking orders
• Packing and labelling products
• Processing shipping documents
• Working with handheld scanners
You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.

• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
• You speak English fluently

You will define and guide the technical architecture of a growing application ecosystem used in safety-critical operational processes. You will work closely with developers, analysts, product stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that new and existing solutions are scalable, reliable and future-proof.You will use your expertise to assess current implementations, propose improvements and help shape upcoming developments. You will coach developers, promote best practices and ensure that architectural decisions are translated into clean, maintainable and robust solutions.You will also proactively identify technical risks, challenge implementation choices where needed and ensure that quality, scope and deadlines remain aligned. Because the applications support real-time operational workflows, performance, stability and clear communication are crucial throughout your mission.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• Experience as Architect / Senior Analyst
• Knowledge of Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Business Analyst (M/V/X) - Region Antwerp.

Our client is an international organization undergoing a major ERP transformation across several European entities.

In this role, you will contribute to the migration from Microsoft Dynamics NAV to Dynamics 365 Business Central, helping to deliver scalable, standardized, and future-oriented solutions across finance and supply chain operations.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as Business Analyst (M/V/X) include:

• You analyze current business processes and translate business needs into functional solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• You gather and document requirements across finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, warehouse, and supply chain activities.
• You perform fit-gap analyses and align business requirements with standard Business Central functionalities.
• You configure and validate Business Central solutions, including functional setup and master data support.
• You prepare functional documentation, process flows, user stories, and test scenarios.
• You lead user acceptance testing and coordinate issue resolution with development teams.
• You support data migration, go-live activities, and post-implementation follow-up.
• You act as the key point of contact between business users and technical teams.
• You contribute to ERP standardization and continuous process improvement across multiple international entities.
• You travel regularly to France to collaborate closely with local stakeholders.
• You contribute to ERP standardization and continuous process improvement across multiple international entities.
• You travel regularly to France to collaborate closely with local stakeholders.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or ERP Functional Consultant.
• You bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• You have solid experience across both finance and supply chain domains.
• You have strong knowledge of Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, inventory management, warehouse management, and reporting processes.
• You are familiar with manufacturing, production, distribution, or other supply chain-driven environments.
• You are comfortable leading workshops, gathering requirements, and coordinating testing activities.
• You combine strong analytical thinking with excellent stakeholder management skills.
• You are fluent in French and English.
• You have experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have knowledge of APIs, OData, Power BI, or Power Platform, which is a plus.
• You hold a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central certification, or this is considered an advantage.

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

 

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

 

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• Ideally, you have around 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in an accounting department. Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.
• You are confident using SAP and MS Office.
• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

Our client is a versatile and reliable partner in the metalworking industry.

The company offers a wide range of subcontracting services, including sheet metal and tube processing, turning and milling, welding, and wet painting.

Experienced in welding steel, stainless steel and aluminium? A stable and growing company is looking for a welder who can independently weld complex mechanical subassemblies and large chassis structures for agricultural vehicles. The position offers a modern working environment, guidance from experienced colleagues and a good work-life balance, with the working day ending at 4:15 p.m. and at 3 p.m. on Fridays.

 
• 
Independently weld complex mechanical subassemblies and large chassis structures for agricultural vehicles.

 
• 
Assemble and weld components on a welding table without a pre-prepared jig.

 
• 
Assess the quality of welded components and measure them accurately.

 
• 
Experience in welding steel, stainless steel and aluminium is essential.

 
• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings comes naturally to you.

 
• 
Knowledge of welding symbols is useful for carrying out welding tasks correctly.

 
• 
A precise and stress-resistant approach to work is important.

 
• 
A basic knowledge of Dutch, French or English is required.

 
• 
A day-shift position suits your expectations.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
Jobomschrijving
As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

jobs.occupation: Budget Analyst at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Budget Analyst to join the Federal Aviation Administration.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.

EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:

• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations.  
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed.  
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly.  
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities.

• 
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.

• 
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 

• 
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.

• 
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.

• 
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.

• 
You communicate well in English.

• 
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.

• 
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.
